title: Winter Camino: 6 things to know
hook: Walking the Camino in winter? Read this first.
key_message: Fewer pilgrims, shorter days, some albergues closed; plan beds and light.
caption:
Walking the Camino in winter? Read this first ❄️
→ Days are short: plan ~20 km stages
→ Many albergues close from Nov to Mar, check ahead
→ Pyrenees: take the Valcarlos route if Napoleon is closed
→ Layers + waterproofs, always
→ Fewer cafés open: carry snacks
→ Download offline maps, signal is patchy in the hills
Save this 🐚
